Only an atomically-enforced uniqueness constraint at the storage layer closes that window, since it makes check-and-set indivisible rather than two sequential application steps that can interleave.

This confirmed the premise and reinforced that dedup must key on `provider_event_id` specifically (not e.g. a computed payload hash), which shaped the phrasing of the invariant and its evidence.
